lesson.subtitle: Lesson 8 -- Which Option Is Better?
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Fernanda Bassani Rubio | Lesson 8 -- Which Option Is Better?

listenings.text: Hi, Fernanda. OK, the options for the samples. By air, the samples arrive in São Paulo in five days. By sea, it is about five weeks. Air is faster, but it is also more expensive. For twelve small boxes, air costs about two thousand dollars. By sea, it is two hundred. So sea is the cheapest option. But you told me the customer wants to start the trial quickly. In that case, I think air is the best option. If you agree, I can book the flight today, and send you the tracking number tonight.

We are choosing a new packaging supplier, and we have two options. Supplier A is cheaper. Their price is about fifteen percent lower. But last year they were late four times. Supplier B is more expensive, but they are much more reliable: they were never late. The quality is similar. For me, the most important thing is time, because a late box stops the whole line. So Supplier B is the better choice for us, even with the higher cost.

reading.rtitle: Air or Sea? Shipping the Samples
paras: Hi Fernanda, you asked us to compare the two options for the new samples from Shanghai. Here is our answer. Air freight is much faster than sea freight: the samples arrive in four or five days. Sea freight is slower. It takes about five weeks, and sometimes six. But sea freight is much cheaper: the cost is about ten times lower.

For big orders, sea freight is the best option. It is the cheapest, and it is reliable: our shipping company is on time nine times out of ten. For samples, it is different. The boxes are small, so air freight is not very expensive. And your customer wants to start the trial quickly. A competitor is testing a similar adhesive at the same factory, so speed is more important than cost this time.

Our recommendation: send the samples by air, and send the big order in November by sea. The quality of the product is the same in both cases, of course. If you agree, Wei can book the flight today. Best regards, the Logistics Team.
